literal_cells: 2307078 / AMR-022-7078 — Rubel, Hayman–Lingham Problem 7.78: planar unit-charge reciprocal-difference sums over infinite pairwise distinct nonzero z_n with sum 1/|z_n|<infinity.

Already established: J. Clunie, A. Eremenko and J. Rossi, On Equilibrium Points of Logarithmic and Newtonian Potentials, Journal of the London Mathematical Society (2)47(2)(1993),309–320. Printed p.310 before Theorem2.1 states the full distinct-point unit-charge conclusion: S(z)=sum 1/(z−z_n) has infinitely many distinct zeros away from its poles, so no zero-free example exists. Hayman–Lingham arXiv:1809.07200v2, printed pp.185–186 and Update7.78/reference[163], already records the planar resolution. Existing1993 publication; https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1301 provides AI-assisted unrefereed exposition and an independently checked elementary reconstruction only. No new publication, DOI reservation, novelty or historical-firstness claim. Arbitrary positive real charges, higher-dimensional Newtonian analogues and their current status are outside this recorded scope.
